title: Record the source value that restores register 359
body:
## Summary
- Immediately before event 24433, register 103 holds `-128` when register 359 starts at `1`. The data register contributes `0`.
- The addition multiplies that value by `-1/128`. Register 359 is `0`, so the addition restores it to `1`.
- Register 103 is `-64` after event 23507 and `-128` after event 24280. No selected frontier change and no new exponent.
